static_cross_match.condition: When (device[0x2ABD] & 0x02) != 0 and *(u32 *)(device + 0x5404) == 0, the PPC path reaches the no-op epilogue before its only CP_RB_WPTR store.
static_cross_match.evidence: Qualified Ghidra decompilation of Default.xex in ace-combat-6-demo; the runtime observation supplies the branch operands rather than names for the private fields.

ring_handoff.pre_final_execution: The ordered tick-0 receipt places all four observed CP_RB_WPTR writes before the second VdInitializeRingBuffer. The current primary batches are consumed synchronously and completely (22 then 3 dwords; no pending WAIT).
ring_handoff.bridge_cross_match: GuestBridge::configure_xenos_ring resets ring-local telemetry when base or size changes, but it does not clear the command processor, typed commands, renderer mailbox, or a pending stream. The post-final report still retains the two shader loads and 24 draws decoded from the pre-final bootstrap work.
ring_handoff.result: No submitted or pending first-ring work is discarded by the observed reconfiguration. A zero-submission snapshot of the final ring is therefore not evidence that the earlier bootstrap batch was lost.

conclusion.result: The covered post-final invocation returns through the suppressing branch and therefore cannot issue CP_RB_WPTR. This is not, on its own, evidence that a final-ring publication is required for the already-completed bootstrap batch.
closed: The native guest-to-CP MMIO bridge did not drop a WPTR store on this invocation.
The pre-final tick-0 writes cannot be treated as a submission of the final ring.
not_established: A semantic name or rendering role for the undocumented D3D private-tail fields +0x2ABD and +0x5404.
